## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a user can do after this change. Link the relevant issue.

## Scope

Select the affected areas:

- [ ] Self-hosted web app / backend
- [ ] JavaFX desktop
- [ ] MCP adapter / import skill
- [ ] Packaging / database / operations
- [ ] Documentation / accessibility

## Verification

List tests or manual checks performed and their results. State any checks you could not run.
For visible UI changes, include cursor-free screenshots with fictional data.

## Data and compatibility

Describe migrations, API changes, retry/conflict behavior, and backup/restore or upgrade implications.
Write “None” when this change does not affect these areas.

## Submission checks

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation matches its final behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, personal records, databases, exports, private notes, or private screenshots are included.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; behavior changes have meaningful regression coverage where appropriate.
- [ ] Applied migrations remain unchanged; schema updates use a new migration.
- [ ] Dependencies and included assets retain their required licenses/notices.
